# Your Working Day
When you haven't been given a specific task, we expect you to keep busy at the Company work terminals. Everything you earn at a terminal goes straight into the site's budget, and that budget pays for the site's supplies, staff and growth.
Try to vary your work. Doing the same task over and over pays less each time, and the auditors notice when someone's been coasting.
## Records and Audit Check the site's ledger against its receipts and flag any entry that doesn't match. Every mistake you catch saves the Company money.
## Logistics Plan the freight for outgoing shuttles. Get as much value into each load as you can without going over the weight, volume or hazard limits. The shuttle crew will turn away an overloaded manifest, so double-check your work.
## Secure Transmissions Decode intercepted radio traffic by working out its cipher key. The terminal tells you how close each guess is. Harder traffic pays more.
## Corporate Markets Trade goods and commodities on the Company's account. - Prices move all the time. The chart closes a new candle every minute. - The Company newswire reports market news before the market reacts, so keep an eye on it. - Large trades move the price. If you buy a lot at once, you'll pay more for the last units than the first. - There's a 2% brokerage fee on every trade, and the Company's holdings pay a small dividend every minute. - The site can only hold up to $10,000 in goods at once.
Only trade with the Company's money on a Company terminal. Personal investments are your own business, so use your own desktop for those.
## Reporting If something important happens, tell the Liaison. Bad news is easier to deal with early, and good news should be shared as soon as possible.
